analysis_plan_freeze.note: Frozen before the first experiment run on the 2026-11-23 canonical dataset

data_provenance.warning: Records are generated from a small number of Synthea source patients (e.g. all HEART_FAILURE and all PNEUMONIA test records each come from ONE source patient). Bootstrap CIs resample records and therefore understate uncertainty; per-class results for those classes describe single synthetic patients. See also sensitivity_grouped_cv_posthoc.

rq1_multiseed_comparison.note: Mean ± SD over seeds; CI95 = record-level bootstrap (B=2000; records share Synthea source patients, so CIs understate uncertainty - see data_provenance) on the seed with lowest validation NLL. Comparisons: deployment model (xattn_frozen) minus comparator, Holm-adjusted over all comparators.

rq2_text_signal_decomposition.note: Mean macro AUROC over seeds 13/42/101 (TF-IDF deterministic). Variants defined in src/data_pipeline/note_variants.py. Tabular-only models do not use notes; their AUROC is the reference a fusion model can fall back to.

rq3_complementarity_simulation.note: SIMULATION (docs/11_ANALYSIS_PLAN.md A.3): class cues injected into number-masked notes for a fraction rho of patients (10% wrong-class cues); Gaussian noise sigma*SD on tabular features. Mean of seeds 13/42. Measures mechanism, not clinical performance.

rq4_calibration.note: All calibrators fitted on validation (N=273) only; metrics on strict test (N=302).

rq4_missing_modality.note: Mean macro AUROC over seeds. Missing text = empty note string encoded by the same BERT; missing tabular = train median / mode; random missingness imputed with train median (analysis plan section 4). Models were trained on complete data (no modality dropout).

rq4_dca.hypothetical_intervention: NT-proBNP + siêu âm tim sớm (analysis plan 3.2)
rq4_dca.formula: Net reduction per 100 = (NB_model - NB_treat_all) * (1 - p_t) / p_t * 100 (Vickers 2016)
rq4_dca.prevalence_note: HF prevalence 35.1% in the synthetic test set; net benefit is a within-cohort comparison and does not transfer to primary care.

metadata.disclaimer: Synthetic cohort: subgroup results describe the pipeline, not fairness on real patients.

gender_F.note: one-vs-rest AUROC averaged over the classes present in this subgroup only

age_65_and_older.note: one-vs-rest AUROC averaged over the classes present in this subgroup only

smoking_NEVER.note: one-vs-rest AUROC averaged over the classes present in this subgroup only

smoking_FORMER.note: one-vs-rest AUROC averaged over the classes present in this subgroup only

smoking_CURRENT.note: fewer than two classes present (or empty subgroup) - not estimable

generalization.split_method: Temporal split, group-aware (patient + note source groups ordered by earliest encounter; 70/15/15)
generalization.validation_nature: Internal robustness check on synthetic timestamps - NOT external hospital validation

sensitivity_grouped_cv_posthoc.design: StratifiedGroupKFold(5) over all 2,000 rows on merged patient+note groups; 15% of remaining groups as validation; seed 42 (docs/11_ANALYSIS_PLAN.md A.6)

dca.hypothetical_intervention: NT-proBNP + siêu âm tim sớm (analysis plan 3.2)
dca.formula: Net reduction per 100 = (NB_model - NB_treat_all) * (1 - p_t) / p_t * 100 (Vickers 2016)
dca.prevalence_note: HF prevalence 35.1% in the synthetic test set; net benefit is a within-cohort comparison and does not transfer to primary care.

robustness.note: Mean macro AUROC over seeds. Missing text = empty note string encoded by the same BERT; missing tabular = train median / mode; random missingness imputed with train median (analysis plan section 4). Models were trained on complete data (no modality dropout).

rag.qdrant_sync_scope_note: Read-only check verified 768-D vector dimension, chunk_id set, text_content SHA-256, and 8 provenance metadata fields against data/guidelines/*.json; it does NOT verify semantic embedding quality because offline deterministic 768-D hashed fallback vectors are active instead of all-mpnet-base-v2.
rag.retrieval_scope_note: Recall/MRR/nDCG metrics reflect live Qdrant RRF using deterministic 768-D hashed fallback vectors (all-mpnet-base-v2 offline unavailable), NOT a real semantic encoder.

grounding_audit_50_cases.audit_scope_limitation: Automatic metrics verify character-offset substring matching on display_note and rejection of out-of-note probe strings only; they do NOT establish semantic correctness, negation fidelity, or clinical validity. Evaluated on canonical strict N=302 hold-out split.

/api/v1/predict/baseline.note: HTTP 503 baseline_models_unavailable safeguard (default when Member 1 fitted baseline models are absent).

/api/v1/predict/multimodal.note: HTTP 503 safeguard measured (multimodal inference NOT exercised: missing torch in deploy image or missing Bio_ClinicalBERT cache).

superseded.member2_backlog09_2026-11-19: DCA, robustness, temporal and fairness numbers produced by scripts/evaluate_research_hardening_member2.py on the 2026-11-18 dataset are withdrawn: that dataset leaked labels through unredacted diagnoses and reused MTSamples notes (TF-IDF AUROC 0.962 with numbers masked); the script trained its own fusion model without validation and with a fixed temperature of 1.15, and the intervention formula divided by p_t instead of p_t/(1-p_t).
